dialogues.en: "Wait for me outside. I'll go with you after I change."
dialogues.text: "Wait for me outside. I'll go with you after I change."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん起きてる？」
dialogues.en:
"Won't it be weird for to walk with me if I'm in my
uniform?"
dialogues.text:
"Won't it be weird for to walk with me if I'm in my
uniform?"

dialogues.jp: う。
dialogues.en: "I don't think so."
dialogues.text: "I don't think so."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en:
"I'll look like a sister who's being walked to school,
rather than a couple."
dialogues.text:
"I'll look like a sister who's being walked to school,
rather than a couple."

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか知らないが、急に酸欠になって目が覚
めた。
dialogues.en: "That's what we are...... what a pain."
dialogues.text: "That's what we are...... what a pain."

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁはぁ……あ？」
dialogues.en: I reached out for my uniform.
dialogues.text: I reached out for my uniform.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あははは……バ――じゃなかった兄さん、お
　はよう」
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.jp: 間抜けな返事をしてしまう。
dialogues.en: "Wait outside."
dialogues.text: "Wait outside."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「びっくりしたぁ。急に起き上がるから、おで
　こがぶつかるかと思ったよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
制服姿の音夢が、薄い赤色の唇をおさえてはに
かむ。
dialogues.en: Nemu kissed me on my cheek and stepped outside.
dialogues.text: Nemu kissed me on my cheek and stepped outside.

dialogues.jp: 夢？
あまりにも日常的な風景に首をかしげてしまう。

チラリと携帯を見るが、液晶の日付はきちんと
春休みだし、いつも通り１日分しか進んでいな
かった。
dialogues.en: I touched on my cheek and smiled.
dialogues.text: I touched on my cheek and smiled.

dialogues.en: I think I smile a lot lately.
dialogues.text: I think I smile a lot lately.

dialogues.jp: 寝起きでいまいち覚えていない。
dialogues.en: I wonder what my parents would say when they come back......
dialogues.text: I wonder what my parents would say when they come back......

dialogues.jp: なぜか頭が混乱していた。
dialogues.en: I changed into my uniform and picked up my wallet.
dialogues.text: I changed into my uniform and picked up my wallet.

dialogues.jp:
背中に手を回してかがみこみ、音夢がベッドに
腰掛ける俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 本当に、ようやく頭が回るようになる。
dialogues.en: I stepped on something.
dialogues.text: I stepped on something.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の唇の感触をもっとちゃんとしっかりと感
じたくて……ではないはずだ。たぶん。
dialogues.en: "A cherry blossom?"
dialogues.text: "A cherry blossom?"

dialogues.jp: 「しかし……お前、大丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en: I picked it up, and it span around in my hand.
dialogues.text: I picked it up, and it span around in my hand.

dialogues.jp: なんとも感慨深い音夢の反応だが。
dialogues.en:
I didn't notice it before, and I wonder where it came
from......
dialogues.text:
I didn't notice it before, and I wonder where it came
from......

dialogues.jp: 「迷惑だなんて思ってない！」
dialogues.en: "Oh well."
dialogues.text: "Oh well."

dialogues.jp: 思わず声が大きくなる。
dialogues.en:
I put the cherry blossom in my shirt pocket and went
outside. II was feeling happy but I didn't know why.
dialogues.text:
I put the cherry blossom in my shirt pocket and went
outside. II was feeling happy but I didn't know why.

dialogues.jp: 思わず声が大きくなる。
dialogues.en: Even usual everyday life is enough to make me happy......
dialogues.text: Even usual everyday life is enough to make me happy......

dialogues.jp: ◆とある朝の出来事◆
dialogues.en: ◆A sad physiological phenomenon◆
dialogues.text: ◆A sad physiological phenomenon◆

dialogues.jp:
お腹がすいたと騒ぐ音夢にサンドイッチを作っ
てやると言うと、はしゃいで抱きつかれる。
dialogues.en:
I tried to act like nothing had happened as I cleared my
throat.
dialogues.text:
I tried to act like nothing had happened as I cleared my
throat.

dialogues.jp:
だけど、抱きつかれて、何度も音夢が眠りに落
ちてしまっているから、俺は音夢を引き剥がし
た。
dialogues.en:
I told her to wait outside while I change, as I told her
that I'll go with her.
dialogues.text:
I told her to wait outside while I change, as I told her
that I'll go with her.

dialogues.jp: 不安を感じる音夢。
dialogues.en: Then, I found a cherry blossom falling in my room.
dialogues.text: Then, I found a cherry blossom falling in my room.

dialogues.jp: 俺はバカだ。
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it, it's a physiological phenomenon."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it, it's a physiological phenomenon."

dialogues.jp:
そんな仮定で音夢に寂しい思いをさせてしまう
なんて……。
ギュッと、俺は音夢を抱きしめた。
dialogues.en: She cleared her throat, and moved away.
dialogues.text: She cleared her throat, and moved away.
